scientific_question: Can held-out causal contradictions produce a non-vacuous ground-truth-free lower bound on CDFM graph error?
formal_target: ground-truth-free minimum structural repair / graph-error lower-bound certificate

data.split: first 500 rows discovery, last 500 rows validation; standardization fit on discovery only

candidate_graph.raw_output: CDFM adjacency and edge probabilities from X_discovery
candidate_graph.projection: For each unordered pair retain the selected orientation with larger probability; sort retained edges by descending probability and greedily reject any edge that creates a directed cycle.
candidate_graph.tie_break: higher probability, then smaller source index, then smaller target index

witnesses.statements: For every candidate node Y, test Y independent of each non-descendant non-parent X given Pa_candidate(Y).
witnesses.multiple_testing: Holm step-down over every local-Markov statement generated for one task
witnesses.witness: a statement with Holm-adjusted rejection at alpha

repair.distance: directed pairwise SHD; add, delete, or reverse one unordered-pair state costs one
repair.space: DAGs on the same ten observed nodes
repair.search: exhaustive pair-state enumeration with DAG pruning for k=0,1,2,3
repair.no_solution_by_max_k: report RR_lower_bound=4 and rr_exact=false; claim only RR >= 4
repair.witness_resolution: a repaired DAG resolves a witness only when it does not d-separate the tested pair given the fixed candidate parent set

evaluation.truth: opened only after certificate predictions and pre_truth_hashes.json
evaluation.tightness: RR_lower_bound / true SHD for true SHD > 0

gate.BORDERLINE: validity passes but one or more non-vacuity conditions fail
gate.STOP: validity fails, including any frequent RR_lower_bound > true SHD pattern
gate.INCONCLUSIVE: technical failure rate exceeds 10 percent or an evaluation denominator is empty
